result:
Build succeeds cleanly with 0 warnings/errors. The three new operations are implemented in `FolderSync.calr`:

- **`RecordDelete`** — reads the existing tombstone stamp via `IndexStamp` (`-1` if absent); leaves the file unchanged when `existing >= stamp`, otherwise upserts through `WriteIndexEntry` (inheriting its replace-in-place/append rules).
- **`SyncTwoWay`** — captures the target-only names at the start (before any writes), then processes source entries in source order, then those target-only names in target order. Deletion triggers on `d >= max(s,t)` (encoded as `(&& (>= d s) (>= d t))`), removing from each index where present and counting each removal; otherwise newer-wins upserts into target (`s>t`) or source (`t>s`); equal stamps are a no-op. The tombstone is only read, never modified.
- **`SyncWithPolicy`** — delegates to `SyncTwoWay` when `twoWay` is true, else to the existing `Sync` (which ignores tombstones entirely).

Existing operations are untouched, so their behavior is preserved. The edit passed the calor compile/contract/effect/reference checks, and `dotnet build` is clean.
